what: While the big title line grows from .1x over 1 second, characters slide in one by one alternately from above and below (even −100%, odd 100%) in random order at .03s intervals

options.on: “enter” triggers when it enters the screen, without it, as soon as it loads
options.dur: Duration in seconds for the line to grow from .1x, default 1
options.in: Length the text slides in (seconds), default 0.7
options.each: Gap between letters (seconds), default 0.03. Time to finish is delay + max(dur, in + each × (letter count − 1)) seconds (1 second for three letters)

use:
HereLarge title

— Default is the original length (1s)
